caption: The dashboard of a user: profile, notifications and the left menu with Admin and Super admin.
The Admin start page with the blocks My admin parts, AI use, Standard installations and About Easy2edit.
Standard installations: one small tile per type of website, with Set and a gear for the settings.
The settings of a standard installation in a pop-up with tabs: General, AI, Modules and Demo data.
The Super admin start page: modules, plugins, prices, AI and the system tools.
Super admin > Modules: switch modules on or off and give them to users and groups.
Admin > Pages: the pages and the menu of the website.
System objects: parts of other modules that you can place on a page in edit mode.
Site import: drop HTML files, check the proposal, then apply it to your pages.
Admin > Theme: colours, fonts, roundings and theme packs.
The media library with all images and videos.
Admin > Languages: the languages of the website.
Admin > Users: accounts, roles and blocking.
Admin > Roles: the rights of a role, including viewing the AI use of users.
Admin > Security: login lock, country control, age check, cookies and forbidden words.
Subscriptions that give access to parts of the site.
Admin > Community: profiles, messages and chat.
Admin > SEO: search engines, bots and AI agents.
Admin > FAQ: your own frequently asked questions.
Super admin > AI > Overview: key figures, costs over time per group, and the latest calls.
AI > Users: heavy users, highest costs and a PDF report per user.
AI > Credit: the credit rules, the amounts of a top-up and the credit per user.
AI > Settings: margins per group, currencies and the rate.
AI > Settings > Claude: the models that are active in the API, with the price per million tokens and per token.
Admin > AI: the use of your users, without purchase prices.
Buying AI credit: a slider with a suggestion based on your use.
Admin > API keys: the links to external systems, with the Superadmin label.
Admin > Plugins: install, switch on and update plugins.
Admin > Backups: back up and restore the site.
The web shop plugin: products, groups, shipping methods and discount codes.
Orders: all orders of the shop, subscriptions and donations.
